principles: Do not weaken the read-only or PLAN-only milestone contract validated by the B-b550 audit
Prefer additive, no-behavior-change closes; keep boundary-tightening local and test-backed
Design decisions (gate-mode default, stale-evidence reconciliation) are recorded in decision docs, not blindly flipped
Every hardening is proven by a test or an explicit recorded decision
drivers: Six audit-identified hardening gaps must each be closed or explicitly decided
observe->enforce gate-mode is a wide-blast-radius behavior change across every milestone-triggered story
Must not break existing DONE flows (e.g. B-b550's own confirmed-ledger closeout)

options.name: additive-first-conservative
pros: Low blast radius, no behavior change
cons: not_applicable justification field is optional, not retroactively enforced on legacy rows

options.name: aggressive-enforce-mandatory
cons: Flips gate-mode observe->enforce for ALL milestone-triggered stories
Mandatory field breaks existing confirmed ledgers
Risks breaking B-b550 closeout and in-flight stories

rationale: The B-b550 audit confirmed the milestone surface is safe today; the goal is to close observability/coverage gaps and tighten the boundary locally WITHOUT a behavior change. additive-first-conservative closes all six M7 findings with tests plus recorded decisions, keeps the read-only/PLAN-only contract intact, keeps gate-mode default observe (with recorded rationale), and avoids the wide-blast-radius enforce flip and mandatory-field migration that could break existing DONE flows including B-b550 own closeout.

preMortem.scenario: Disclaimer line shifts report line positions
preMortem.trigger: An external tool scrapes milestone_status output by fixed line number
preMortem.mitigation: Insert as a NEW line; keep Mode/Phase/Ledger lines unchanged; tests assert by substring not line position

preMortem.scenario: notApplicableDecision field changes an existing confirmed ledger hash
preMortem.trigger: Adding the field to the ledger schema/hash
preMortem.consequence: Legacy confirmed ledgers (e.g. B-b550) become invalid
preMortem.mitigation: Make the field optional and migration-safe; do not retroactively invalidate legacy confirmed ledgers

preMortem.scenario: Closeout reconciliation lets a vacuous/stale ledger pass DONE
preMortem.trigger: Making closeout non-throwing without moving strictness elsewhere
preMortem.consequence: A confirmed-but-vacuous or stale ledger silently satisfies DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Move strictness into the designed evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence gate; add negative-control tests CHK-004/005/010 proving vacuous/stale ledgers do not pass

preMortem.scenario: Wiring milestone-status.test.mjs into run-all-smokes surfaces a latent failure
preMortem.trigger: The previously-skipped test now runs in the aggregate suite
preMortem.mitigation: Run it standalone first and fix any real issue before wiring it into run-all-smokes
